mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener - Top Customer
mcp:tool-listener.name: get-top-customer-by-revenue
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
Retrieve the top N customers by total revenue from Salesforce.
The customers are sorted by Total Revenue in descending order, with the highest-revenue customers returned first. The input parameter "num" specifies the maximum number of customers to return.
The response always contains the available customer records in a table format with the following columns: Customer ID, Customer Name, Account Number, Email, Joined Date, Tenure (Years), Valid Till, Last Billing Date, Total Revenue, Autopay Enabled, Contact Preference, Churn Score, and Churn Risk Level.
If fewer than N matching customers are available, all available matching customers are returned.

logger.doc:name: Log - Request Received
logger.message: #["[top-customer-by-revenue-flow] Tool invoked - num: " ++ (payload.num as String default "null")]

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountNumber, Email__c, Phone, Valid_Till__c, Total_Revenue__c, Churn_Score__c, Contact_Preferances__c FROM Account WHERE AccountNumber LIKE 'ACC%' ORDER BY Total_Revenue__c DESC LIMIT :num

logger.doc:name: Log - Query Result
logger.message: #["[top-customer-by-revenue-flow] Salesforce query returned " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " records"]
